changes.newText: Superadmins can control how long Backend.AI keeps each kind of record on the Data Retention tab of the Maintenance page. The tab appears only when the connected manager supports retention policies (26.8.0 or later). Old records are cleaned up only for categories whose policy is enabled.
changes.newHtml: Superadmins can control how long Backend.AI keeps each kind of record on the Data Retention tab of the Maintenance page. The tab appears only when the connected manager supports retention policies (26.8.0 or later). Old records are cleaned up only for categories whose policy is enabled.

changes.newText: Each row of the list is the policy for one category and shows its Category, Retention Period (Days), an Enabled switch, and the Last Cleanup time (or "Not run yet"). The Created At and Updated At columns can be shown from the table settings. The available categories are Logs, Login History, Reconcile History, Roles & Invitations, Deployments, Sessions, Usage Records, and Usage Buckets. The list can be sorted by Category, Last Cleanup, or Created At.

changes.newText: Create Policy: Click Create Policy, choose a category, enter a retention period of at least 1 day, and choose whether the policy is enabled. Only one policy can exist per category, so categories that already have a policy are disabled in the category list.
changes.newHtml: Create Policy: Click Create Policy, choose a category, enter a retention period of at least 1 day, and choose whether the policy is enabled. Only one policy can exist per category, so categories that already have a policy are disabled in the category list.

changes.newText: Edit: Use the edit action in the row to change the retention period or the enabled setting. The category can be moved only to a category that has no policy yet.
changes.newHtml: Edit: Use the edit action in the row to change the retention period or the enabled setting. The category can be moved only to a category that has no policy yet.

changes.newText: Enabled switch: Turn a policy on or off directly from the list, without opening the editor.
changes.newHtml: Enabled switch: Turn a policy on or off directly from the list, without opening the editor.

changes.newText: Delete: Use the delete action in the row. Because the policy is removed permanently, you must type the category name shown in the dialog before the delete button is enabled.
